# TdsQueryExecutor

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.TdsQueryExecutor`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Executes SQL queries against Dataverse&#x27;s TDS Endpoint using the SQL Server wire protocol. The TDS Endpoint provides read-only access to Dataverse data on port 5558.
